categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Haili Wind Power Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of wind power equipment components, focusing on offshore wind power. Its main products include wind turbine towers, pile foundations, jacket foundations, and booster stations, covering large-capacity products of 12MW and above. The company also engages in new energy development and wind farm construction and operation services, structured into three main business segments: equipment manufacturing, new energy development, and construction & operation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced manufacturing technologies including automated welding, precision flange welding, thick plate rolling, and surface anti-corrosion treatments tailored for offshore wind power equipment. It has developed proprietary technologies and holds 163 patents, including 22 invention patents. Production methods incorporate digital and intelligent manufacturing systems, CNC cutting, laser cutting, and automated arc welding, ensuring high precision and quality control in large steel structure fabrication.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include wind farm construction contractors, wind farm operators, and wind turbine manufacturers. The company has established strong business relationships with major domestic wind power operators such as China Energy Group, China Huaneng, China Datang, State Power Investment Corporation, China Huadian, China Three Gorges, and leading turbine manufacturers like Goldwind, Shanghai Electric, Envision Energy, Mingyang Smart Energy, and Dongfang Electric. The primary market is domestic, with growing efforts to expand overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with production bases strategically located in coastal provinces including Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Shandong, and Hainan. It has multiple manufacturing facilities near ports to facilitate logistics and export. The company is actively developing export-oriented bases to expand its international market presence, aligning with its 'offshore + overseas' dual strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Haili Wind Power Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the wind power supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sale of key wind power equipment components. It supplies to downstream wind farm developers, operators, and turbine manufacturers, playing a critical role in the equipment supply for offshore wind power projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in large-capacity offshore wind power components, deep and far-sea wind power products including deep-water jackets, floating foundations, marine ranching platforms, and converter stations. It invests heavily in technology innovation, intelligent manufacturing upgrades, and expanding product lines to meet evolving market demands. Strategic initiatives include building a centralized headquarters for R&D and digital transformation, expanding production capacity, and strengthening overseas market development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of wind power equipment components such as towers, pile foundations, and jackets. The company follows a direct sales model with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. Additional income streams include investment income from wind farm operations and other business activities related to new energy development and wind farm construction and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of offshore wind power equipment components with a strong market share in large-capacity products. It competes with a limited number of firms capable of providing full sets of offshore wind equipment including towers, foundations, and substations. Competitive advantages include advanced technology, quality control, strategic production base layout, and strong customer relationships. The company faces competition from other domestic and international manufacturers expanding into offshore wind equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.35 billion, a 19.63% decrease from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 66.1 million, turning profitable after prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 9.52 billion, up 23.23% year-over-year. The company has shown significant growth in cash flow from operations and continues to invest in expanding production capacity and R&D. Despite short-term revenue decline, the company maintains a positive growth trajectory supported by strategic investments and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced offshore wind power equipment tailored for large-capacity turbines and deep-sea applications. Its value proposition includes superior product reliability, precision manufacturing, comprehensive product coverage for 12MW+ turbines, and integrated solutions including marine ranching and floating foundations. Strategic location of production bases near ports reduces logistics costs and enhances delivery efficiency. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading industry players to maintain competitive differentiation.
